reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Defined HO break, donor availability and resection-mutant comparisons with physical DNA and division measurements.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-experiment consultation/check of original Methods, supplements or validated protocols to select and transfer detailed conditions; establishing local prerequisites alone is insufficient.

Processing dependence would place a required processing step in the pathway, not prove that RAD9 itself senses the intermediate. The later caveat about unidentified sensor proteins conflicts with this strongest claimed conclusion.
HO induction/termination schedule, repair-donor structure, assay conditions and resection perturbation remain unspecified without a concrete calibration-to-executable workflow.

checks.quote: single-stranded DNA formation at the break is abolished
checks.reason: Claiming absent intermediate requires a calibrated ssDNA assay detection limit, reference and interference check; no such quantitative calibration is given. A 90% cutting threshold does not establish this separate assay sensitivity.
Bulk Southern/qPCR from matched fixed-time samples cannot assign a lesion state to the same individual releasing cell. Culture-level and single-cell claims must be separated explicitly.

checks.quote: set by a power calculation from calibration variance
checks.reason: A calculation is promised, but the meaningful effect and target power/precision are not specified or operationally derived; n>=3 with 50-100 cells is not a justified culture-level design.

checks.quote: gate single cells on confirmed arrest morphology
checks.reason: Selecting cells by the expected arrest phenotype biases the outcome. Likewise, automatically invalidating a new defined-lesion run because rad9 also arrests discards a potentially genuine RAD9-independent result.
The model family/assumption checks, competing-death handling and multiplicity procedure are not supplied; median comparisons and generic survival analysis do not complete them.

Donor absence does not exclude end joining, and continued HO can recut repaired sites. A persistent population break band is not proof of a permanently unrepaired single lesion. Require pulse/shutoff and repair-product accounting. Primary support: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC1976456/ .

Dose/duration/switch parameters are described as a range or to be calibrated without a bounded ladder or a concrete range-derivation and acceptance-to-lock procedure. This differs from independent assay calibration in P03.
Troubleshooting and pilot separation are present, but no explicit change-control policy requires re-freezing the revised procedure and fresh independent confirmation after technical changes.

A flat dose/timing relationship can reflect saturation, insufficient precision or an unmeasured lesion threshold; it does not identify a timer without quantitative equivalence and competing-model controls. One-break failure likewise need not uniquely establish a lesion-number threshold.

checks.quote: consider an alternative, independent processing block
checks.reason: The second processing perturbation is optional and invoked only if the first is partial; no mandatory orthogonal way separates processing from its direct signaling role. Flow/morphology confirm cell-cycle state but not the causal intermediate mechanism.
Raw movie/lineage/assay identifiers, exact analysis versions/settings and source-to-output records sufficient to reconstruct the study are not specified as a complete audit trail.

The defined-lesion question is valuable and has prospectively matched no-site/inducer, genotype, cutting and processing controls. Source facts are labeled as proposed and 2,885 words meet format. Specific repair/inference faults are charged to P09/P13 rather than generic duplicate deductions.

explanation_reason: The defined-lesion approach is a valid alternative, but repairability/recutting, bulk-to-single-cell attribution and outcome-conditioned gates undermine causal claims. Interpretation remains too categorical.
historical_match_reason: The primary question concerns repair-state versus timer control and temporal RAD9 requirement. It does not ask whether checkpoint initiation AND recovery require new protein synthesis, nor propose verified translation inhibition with corresponding drug controls and both switching readouts. These are scientifically legitimate alternative directions, but none of the five specific synthesis-versus-existing-protein historical components is supplied. Q2 is assessed separately.
